item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Cherry Studio 2.2.1
item.description:
Customize your own AI assistant

Cherry Studio is a Windows, Mac, and Linux-compatible desktop client that supports multiple major language model (LLM) providers. It not only integrates cloud services such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, but also supports the deployment of Ollama and LM Studio native models. Users can use the built-in 300 + preconfigured AI assistants, or custom create a dedicated assistant to talk to multiple models at the same time and get diverse perspectives. At the same time, the app supports a variety of document formats, including text, pictures, Office, and PDF, with WebDAV file management and data backup capabilities. Cherry Studio also provides useful tools such as global search, topic management, AI-driven translation, and ensures a quality experience with light and dark themes and transparent windows that can be used out of the box without additional configuration. Users who like Cherry Studio can support its development through Little Star or sponsored developers.

item.title: FanBar 0.10.0
item.description:
Mac Fan Control Tool

FanBar is a native macOS menu bar temperature monitoring and fan control tool that supports macOS 11 Big Sur and later for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs that can provide readable fan data via AppleSMC. The software displays the CPU temperature, average fan speed, or a combination of the two in the menu bar, and presents the temperature change through a scrolling chart for the last ten minutes, reading the GPU, SSD, and battery temperature when the hardware supports it. Everyday use keeps macOS under automatic thermal management, and after approving a signed control service, you can set a fixed speed, or choose mute, equalize, performance, and extreme thermal presets. Each preset has an independently editable temperature and speed curve that supports CPU, GPU or SSD temperature as the basis for adjustment, and can also restore system control after a specified time. The software provides protection against high-temperature notifications, hardware rpm limits, and attempts to restore automatic control in the event of an abnormality. macOS 14 and later also adds a desktop widget to view the heat dissipation status, and the widget refresh is scheduled by the system.

item.title: TypeWhisper 1.8.3
item.description:
macOS open-source Whisper speech-to-text tool

TypeWhisper is a native speech-to-text tool designed specifically for macOS, focusing on privacy and system-level integration. Users can dictate in any application simply by pressing a global hotkey; the text appears in real-time and is quickly inserted after speaking, with configurable behavior settings. TypeWhisper 1. The stable version 0 provides file transcription functionality, allowing users to drag and drop audio or video files for batch processing and export timestamped SRT or WebVTT subtitle files. It includes various built-in prompts for automated text transcription and supports deeper workflow integration via native API, CLI, and plugins. TypeWhisper emphasizes fully local operation, no telemetry, no subscriptions, no forced cloud dependencies, and voice data is always retained on user devices. The software supports app-aware profiles that automatically switch language, engine, and behavior settings depending on the app or website. History allows all transcriptions to be searched, dictionaries provide correction rules for improved accuracy, and snippets make it easy to store and reuse commonly used text.

item.title: Berthly 1.7.1
item.description:
Native macOS container management tool

Berthly is a native macOS container management application for Apple Silicon Macs, offering a Docker Desktop-like graphical experience for Apple's container tools. It resides in the menu bar and centrally manages images, containers, virtual machines, networks, volumes, and container logs through the SwiftUI window. Users can pull images, build Dockerfiles or Containerfiles, create and run containers, view resources, and monitor logs in real time without frequently using the command line. The software supports drag-and-drop file operations to initiate builds, remembers build parameters, and allows for one-click rebuilds. It provides charts for container CPU, memory, and network usage, offers favorite status notifications, tracks background build progress, and detects image updates. Additionally, it can rebuild containers with their original configurations and retain volume data when new images are discovered. Berthly features a built-in SwiftTerm terminal, a command panel, and full keyboard shortcuts. It supports private image repository logins, network and volume cleanup, as well as guided installation and daemon management for the Apple container toolchain.

item.title: FluidVoice 1.6.13
item.description:
macOS Native Speech-to-Text

FluidVoice is a native macOS speech-to-text app. After pressing the shortcut key, you can speak naturally, and the text will quickly appear in Notes, Slack, Cursor, Gmail, code editors, or anywhere you can enter text. It performs speech recognition locally, without uploading audio to the cloud, balancing privacy with response speed. It is suitable for writing emails, taking notes, chatting, writing code, and continuous dictation over extended periods. The app supports system-level input, offering workflows such as direct dictation, command mode, writing mode, and audio and video transcription, and can also perform AI text refinement as needed. Designed for multilingual environments, it is ideal for users who want to reduce typing and maintain a smooth flow of thought, as well as for Mac users who value transparent architecture and open-source trust. FluidVoice is a native speech-to-text tool for macOS. With a simple press of a hotkey, you can dictate naturally into any text input field, and the system will instantly convert your speech into text with low latency. It is suitable for various scenarios such as writing, communication, programming, and transcription.

item.title: ClashX Meta 1.4.48
item.description:
Lightweight Clash Proxy Client

Clash.Meta is a secondary development version based on the open-source Clash project, with some unique features added, designed to provide a simple and lightweight proxy client. It supports HTTP/HTTPS and SOCKS protocols, offers a Surge-like configuration method, and supports GeoIP rules. Clash.Meta also supports protocols such as Vmess, Shadowsocks, Socks5, and Trojan, and features Netfilter TCP redirection functionality to meet users' diverse needs. Supports Vmess/Shadowsocks/Socks5/Trojan protocols

item.title: PostgresGUI 1.1.7
item.description:
Native PostgreSQL Client

PostgresGUI is a native PostgreSQL graphical client for macOS, focused on providing a lightweight, straightforward, and more Mac-friendly management experience for both local and hosted databases. It can connect to local PostgreSQL and is also compatible with cloud-based PostgreSQL services such as Supabase and Neon. It supports access to protected database environments via SSH tunneling. The software emphasizes privacy and connection security. Database connection information, query statements, and query results are not forwarded through the PostgresGUI server, and sensitive passwords are securely stored using the macOS Keychain. Built using Swift and native macOS technologies, the project relies on PostgresNIO and Swift NIO at its core, providing a modern foundation for network communication and database access. It is suitable for developers, data engineers, and Mac users who need to view and debug PostgreSQL data on a daily basis.

item.title: Warp 0.2026.11.11.08.17.stable_01
item.description:
Powerful Modern Smart Ai Terminal Tools

Warp is a modern terminal and intelligent coding environment for macOS developers that combines traditional command lines, AI coding agents, multi-model scheduling, and team-level governance capabilities in one workflow. Starting from the terminal experience, it supports developers to directly call Claude Code, Codex, Warp Agent and other agents locally. It can also extend the task to run in the cloud through the Oz Agent Platform, which is suitable for complex software engineering scenarios such as code generation, problem troubleshooting, refactoring migration, PR preliminary examination and incident response. Warp Terminal is open source, emphasizing an open agent ecosystem, connectivity to any tool, choice of inference providers and models, and providing codebase indexing, fine-grained permission control, usage visibility, and enterprise compliance capabilities to enable individual developers and teams to organize automated development tasks more efficiently in a familiar command-line interface.

item.title: OnDevice OCR Pro 3.4.4
item.description:
Batch OCR tool for documents on macOS

OnDevice OCR Pro is an offline OCR and batch document processing tool for Mac that turns scans, images and PDFs into full-text searchable content. It runs entirely on your Mac with no cloud or subscription, so sensitive files stay local, which suits legal, medical, financial and office use. It can watch folders and process new documents automatically, with batch recognition, auto-rotation, image enhancement and smart skipping of already digital PDFs. Built-in multilingual OCR covers Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German and more, and it can extract text only to save disk space. It is well suited to invoices, receipts, contracts and research material.

item.title: Ember 1.6.11
item.description:
Private life diary software

Ember: Journal & Life Archive is a private logging tool that combines diary and interpersonal memory archives for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. When writing down daily, just mention a person in the text, and the relevant content will be gathered on the other person's personal page, gradually presenting the common experience, the time of acquaintance and the context of contact; You can also organize people by circles, such as home, work or campus, and use stories to record chapters of life that span many years. Dynamic retrospectives reimagine old memories on the right dates and gently remind you to keep an eye out for people you haven't been in touch with for a long time. The software provides calendars, maps, and people maps to help you navigate through life's snippets from dates, places, and networks, as well as support for searching text throughout your archives and photos. You can add photos, videos, voice memos, Apple Music songs, and weather, and import Day One, Apple Journal, and contacts. The diary is saved on the device and can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or password and synced privately via personal iCloud;

item.title: Verso 1.0.67
item.description:
Native Lightweight Word Processor

Verso Writer is a native lightweight word processor for macOS that emphasizes fast startup, focused writing, and reliable document compatibility. It opens and saves DOCX, Markdown, RTF, ODT, TXT and other common formats for collaboration between Microsoft Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, GitHub and other workflows. The software provides compact toolbars, elegant page layout, focus mode, paperless mode, a variety of page appearance, table of contents, annotations, revisions, footnotes, header and footer, tables, images, find replacements and word count and other writing and typesetting capabilities. Markdown files can be visually edited and preserved in rich text, and code blocks support syntax highlighting; BibTeX and CSL JSON reference management can generate references in multiple formats. The app is built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It does not rely on Electron, web view or cloud account. The interface supports multiple languages. It is suitable for Mac writers who need low burden, privacy-friendly, and full-featured.

item.title: Pinning 2.2
item.description:
Life Story Recording Tool

Pinning – Countdown Events is a powerful countdown and event management app that combines a simple calendar viewer to help users record life stories and track project milestones. Users can easily create a variety of events and organize them in a notebook with a dedicated list of birthdays and anniversaries built in, so important days can be seen at a glance. Events are presented as timelines with support for custom icons or emojis that highlight the countdown or positive timing. The app provides beautiful homepage widgets and lock screen widgets to keep your most important events on your desktop or lock screen for easy viewing at any time. Pinning supports iCloud collaboration for sharing important events with family and friends, as well as syncing upcoming calendar events and scheduled reminders. Users can create recurring events and set notification reminders, use Siri shortcuts to quickly save a single event or event list as a picture, or even import data from a birthday calendar or create a new event from a calendar. Whether tracking birthdays, anniversaries, or managing day-to-day tasks and long-term projects, Pinning delivers the ultimate experience in elegant design and seamless operation for users seeking efficient living records and event planning.

item.title: Tap Autoclicker 2.9.0
item.description:
macOS Mouse Keyboard Autoclick Tool

Tap Autoclicker Tap Bot is a simple and convenient automatic click and refresh tool with numerous features to automate repetitive tasks, saving time and effort for gaming or keeping your system active. Features include: support for left and right mouse button clicks; automatic clicks for different key combinations; click intervals can be set in milliseconds (for M1 and M2 Macs); Start and stop clickers with hotkeys and the ability to set the combination of your preferences; disable clickers by the number of clicks or time; play a tone on click; support full-screen apps and games; delay the start function; be able to set up multiple algorithms for different hotkeys; create and use macros; select the specific location you want to click on the screen; and move the mouse only without clicking. Automating repetitive tasks saves time and effort. It can be used in-game or to keep the system active.

item.title: FletchShot 2.4.0
item.description:
macOS Screenshot Annotation OCR Tool

FletchShot is a screenshot annotation tool designed for macOS, aimed at those who need to quickly take screenshots, draw arrows, and share them instantly every day. As soon as you finish capturing, the annotation window opens immediately, and the arrow tool is selected. After drawing the arrow, grab the bottom edge label of the window and drag it directly into the Slack message Finder or Terminal, and it will be delivered as an image. You can also press Command+C to copy the content with annotations and paste it at any time. The entire process has no save dialog, no mode selection, and no export procedure. Scroll Capture allows you to scroll the target window yourself when long pages extend beyond the screen. The app stitches frames using ScreenCaptureKit, without the need for plugins, extensions, or accessibility permissions. Screen recording supports three modes: full screen, area, or window. Switch to click highlighting with one tap. The footer allows you to switch between MP4 and GIF formats and choose between high, medium, and low video quality. OCR runs on the device side based on Apple's Vision framework. It can extract error message tables, code, and even JSON on the screen as pastable text and automatically indent it. It prioritizes support for English and Japanese.

item.title: AudioMaster 4.4
item.description:
Mac Audio Mastering Software

AudioMaster is an audio mastering and sound enhancement tool for macOS users, suitable for musicians, podcasters, voice actors, and content creators who need to quickly optimize their recordings. The software uses automatic audio algorithms to analyze audio material, adjust the overall level, enhance loudness, and improve the balance and listening experience of the sound, bringing song mixes, voiceovers, presentation recordings, and voice memos closer to the quality of a finished master. Users can either use the adjustable six-band equalizer to fine-tune the frequency bands or quickly select a suitable style from 39 presets covering genres such as podcasts, voiceovers, rock, folk, classical, hip-hop, electronic, jazz, and pop. The software supports the import and export of various audio formats, allowing you to save them as files or share them through the system. It can also handle 24-bit audio material. As an AUv3 audio unit plug-in, it works with compatible DAWs and supports both Audiobus and IAA workflows. The processed master can also be sent directly to MicSwap Remix for track separation and mixing. Gain supports precise adjustment in steps, making it suitable for scenarios such as mobile production, remote recording, and desktop post-production.

item.title: ClipPane 1.1.6
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar Clipboard

ClipPane is a lightweight clipboard history management tool that resides in the macOS menu bar. It automatically saves previously copied text, rich text, images, files, folders, and emojis, helping users quickly retrieve content during frequent copy-and-paste operations, data organization, and office writing tasks. You can bring up the floating history panel with a global shortcut key and re-copy a specific entry with a mouse click, keyboard operation, or the Command + number shortcut key. The built-in search function allows you to locate the desired content from a long history list, and supports copying in the original rich text or plain text format. The software can capture formatted content from applications such as Keynote and PowerPoint, and has optimized startup, scrolling, and panel responsiveness for multiple files, large files, large images, and very long text. Users can adjust the position and layout of the panel, pause the recording of new content, exclude programs that may involve sensitive information by applying a blacklist, and also clear all history with one click. The professional features support storing up to 1,000 records, pinning frequently used items, and dragging and dropping to adjust the pinning order.

item.title: PhotoTransfer 1.2.2
item.description:
Tool for Transferring iPhone Photos to Mac via USB

Photo Transfer is an iPhone and iPad photo import tool for macOS that securely copies photos, videos, Live Photos, and editing-related files to a Mac, external hard drive, or NAS via a USB cable. The software does not require the installation of an app on the phone, nor does it rely on iCloud, Wi-Fi, or the Photos library. The device is opened in read-only mode and will not delete, modify, or write to the phone's content. Before importing, you can preview folders, thumbnails, quantity, and size, and automatically organize directories by date, event, or trip. Custom folder naming rules such as year, month, city, and country are supported. Live Photos, original photos, MOV videos, and AAE editing files will be stored in the same set of folders. Each file undergoes SHA-256 verification, supports resuming transfers after connection loss, copies only new files that do not already exist at the destination, and converts HEIC to JPEG and HEVC to H.264.

item.title: extraDock 5.2.6-beta.1
item.description:
macOS Create Multiple Dock Tools

ExtraDock is a lightweight app designed for macOS users that improves productivity by creating multiple floating docks. It supports macOS 12 and above, and users can customize multiple docks as needed, each of which can set up separate apps, folders, layouts, and behaviors. The software allows the Dock to float freely or be fixed to the edge of the screen, and also supports automatic hiding or storing as needed, saving screen space. ExtraDock also has a full-screen app-aware feature that automatically hides in full-screen mode and recovers location when connected. At the same time, it offers multiple color themes and adjustable dock sizes, allowing users to make arbitrary layouts based on their individual workflows. Users can easily add apps and folders by dragging and dropping. ExtraDock's performance is optimized to ensure low CPU and memory usage and provide a smooth animation experience. ExtraDock is a lightweight application that allows you to create multiple floating Docks on macOS.

item.title: TelunKey 2.1.17
item.description:
Mac Window Switcher

TelunKey is a native macOS keyboard window switching tool developed with Swift that integrates application activation and target window selection into a single keystroke operation for work scenarios that frequently switch between multiple applications, windows, and desktops. The software supports independent triggering of left and right Command and left and right Option, and can also be triggered using Space, which is convenient to configure the operation according to personal habits. After triggering, the actionable target is directly displayed, and the window keyboard layout is mapped to the key position area. The user can confirm the target by pressing the key, reducing the repeated switching between the application and the mouse to find the window. Especially suitable for Chrome multi-window browsing and the scene where a large number of windows work in parallel. TelunKey focuses on low latency response and lightweight background operation, reducing double counting and invalid wake-up by updating window information on demand and lightweight cache. Core data remains on-premises, with no behavioral analysis by default, and no reliance on cloud services. The software supports at least macOS 14.0 Sonoma, which can be installed and updated through Homebrew, and in-app check for updates;

item.title: PasteNow 2.38
item.description:
Lightweight clipboard management tool for macOS

PasteNow is a Mac clipboard management tool that supports data synchronization across multiple devices and the reuse of historical data. It can intelligently categorize clipboard content based on rules and offers various list styles, such as grid views and simple lists, to display the content. Users can preview text, links, and images, and can also add sensitive apps to the exclusion list to protect their privacy. PasteNow relies on iCloud to achieve cloud-based data synchronization, ensuring that clipboard history can be shared across different devices. It also supports full keyboard operation and custom hotkeys to improve operational efficiency. Users can also collect and organize clipboard content using the drag-and-drop feature and selectively save data by setting exclusion rules, providing convenient preview and editing functions. PasteNow is a brand-new clipboard management tool that supports data synchronization across multiple devices, allowing users to easily reuse clipboard history data and categorize history content using rules. Content Preview: Preview clipboard text, links, and image content, with support for HEX color display. Rich views: Clipboard content can be displayed in a variety of styles, including grid view, simple list, and rich list.

item.title: CoolDock 2.2.4-beta.1
item.description:
Mac Dock Enhancement Tool

CoolDock is an intelligent second Dock tool for macOS Sonoma and higher, which does not replace the original Dock of the system, but provides a separate docking bar next to it that can carry real-time components, shortcuts, application entrances, and daily information. Users can centralize music playback, weather, calendar events, reminders, to-dos, pomodoros, system status, searches, clipboards, screenshots, file shelves, download directories, quick switches, and more in one beautiful dynamic dock, reducing the frequency of switching between multiple apps. The software emphasizes local and privacy priorities, and only requests permissions such as calendars, reminders, photos, microphones, accessibility, or automation when required by the relevant features. It also supports app and folder fixing, multiple Dock configurations, floating layouts, resizing and appearance adjustments, wallpaper decoration, and modern Mac workflows with external displays, allowing users to build a more efficient and personalized desktop action center according to their own habits.

item.description: quick management of compressed macOS files

item.title: TabTab 2.2.7
item.description:
Quickly switch between windows and tabs

TabTab is a powerful window and tab management tool designed for Mac to increase user productivity. It supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs and is compatible with macOS 14.0 and above, providing a fast and intuitive experience that runs entirely on your device. TabTab not only manages windows in all Mac apps, but also supports full-screen and split-screen views, allowing you to manage tabs within specific apps like Google Chrome, Safari, Visual Studio Code, and more. TabTab It also has a powerful search feature that allows users to search by app name, window title, and tab title. Rated highly by users for its beautiful packaging, compact local design, optimized hotkeys, and lightning-fast performance, TabTab is considered an indispensable productivity tool on the Mac. Early adopters lauded this as a way for Apple to navigate its tags, praising its smooth, visually pleasing interface and positive response from developers.

item.title: Vidnip 2.0.9
item.description:
macOS Web Video Sniffer Downloader

Vidnip is a video download and media management software for Apple Silicon Mac that supports macOS 14 and above, combining web video detection, download, format conversion, and local playback in one app. After pasting the page link, the software can identify MP4, WebM, HLS/m3u8 and dash videos through traffic monitoring. Combined with the yt-dlp engine, it covers more than 1800 sites, automatically downloads segments in parallel and merges them into a playable MP4, supporting image quality selection, breakpoint continuation, batch link processing and channel update subscription. The built-in video library organizes content by source, filters unwatched items and remembers playback progress; The music library supports audio extraction, album and artist browsing, tag management, and scrolling lyrics. The subtitle feature supports downloading site subtitles, exporting text, and generating subtitles or lyrics using native speech recognition on macOS 26 and above. With the iPhone app, you can also sync music, transfer videos, play back, and remotely send download links.

item.title: NotchPad 2.0.3
item.description:
Liuhai Area Quick Note Tool

NotchPad is a Mac Security Notepad app designed for MacBook Liu Haiping that cleverly integrates notepads, clipboard history, and reusable snippets into the MacBook's Liuhai area, providing quick access with just a mouse hover without switching windows or interrupting current workflows. NotchPad supports rich text editing features, including bold, italics, lists, and other formats, so users can easily pin important notes to the top and quickly find what they need with an instant search. The app enables encryption protection by default, and all data is stored locally on your Mac and never sent to any server for privacy. NotchPad syncs with Apple Notes in both directions. Users can browse and edit Apple Notes in-app, and the changes are instantly returned to the native Notes app. It also supports more than 50 file types, including txt, Markdown, RTF, Word, PDF, and various code files such as Swift, Python, JavaScript, etc. After importing, it will retain a rich text format.

item.title: Keylume 2.4.2
item.description:
macOS Demo Keyboard Tool

Keylume is a stylish on-screen keyboard tool designed for macOS for screen recording and live demo scenes. Keylume provides a complete view of the Apple keyboard, including media keys, arrow keys, and all modifier keys, perfectly matching the look and layout of a real Apple keyboard, many other key visualization tools only show modifier key combinations or omit function keys, while Keylume shows the entire keyboard. Keylume has a variety of beautiful themes built in and an intuitive theme editor that makes it easy for users to create personalized styles, save themes, share them with others, or import themes made by others. Keylume automatically pops up at the start of screen recording and automatically hides after the recording stops, detecting the response in just one second, and also supports manually switching the display by tapping the fn key three times. Keylume supports hovering and tapping fn to enable auto-hiding mode, let the keyboard fade out and allow click penetration, and can freely drag and drag reposition and resize, position information will be automatically remembered. Users can set up app ignore lists to avoid repeated triggering of keyboard displays by background silent recording apps such as backup tools or picture-in-picture utilities.

item.title: NotchNook Pro 2.0.10
item.description:
Mac Smart Island Enhanced Music Control & Lyrics

NotchNook is an efficiency tool that turns the bangs area at the top of the Mac screen into a versatile dashboard that centralizes music control, calendar scheduling, file staging, and device status into a readily available location, without the bangs screen opening the dashboard through a small handle at the top, and supports use on different monitors. Available in Pro and Classic versions, the Pro reimagines the overall experience with 37 features, available in Liquid Glass look or Classic Black style. It supports Spotify, Apple Music, and apps plugged into macOS that are playing, provides lyric display, and can display the calendar in Google Calendar through the system calendar. File trays and AirDrop make it easy to temporarily organize and transfer files, Pro also adds Pocket, Clipboard, File Conversion, Pomodoro, To-Do, Pronunciation, and Terminal, and can approve Claude Code and Codex operation requests in the bangs panel.

item.title: Vitals 1.11.3
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.36
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: Qark 1.2.0
item.description:
Mac Ring Shortcut Menu

Qark is a radial menu tool for macOS that arranges frequently used apps, files, links, shortcuts, text, and groups around the mouse pointer, shortening the access path through circular entry points. By default, hold down Control, Option, and R, and release them after moving to the desired action to execute it. You can also record other keyboard shortcuts or use a mouse button other than the left button to bring up the menu and switch to the tap-and-click operation mode. The software offers seven designs and three materials – Plain, Frost Glass, and Liquid Glass – and allows you to customize the ring and slot content to tailor the interface layout to your personal work habits. Grouped items can be expanded sequentially from their respective slots. Seven interactive events, including opening, hovering, selecting, and closing, are all accompanied by sounds. Corresponding sound effects from other designs can also be selected. The Clean Keys slot can temporarily lock the keyboard for easy wiping and cleaning. The Ring configuration supports exporting and importing for convenient backup and restoration. On supported mice, you can also adjust the scroll wheel's notched or free-scrolling mode.

item.title: DockView 2.6.3
item.description:
Dock Application Window Preview Tool

DockView is a utility designed for macOS that displays previews of selected application windows in the Dock. Users simply hover the mouse over the app icon to see thumbnails of all windows and click on the desired window to switch quickly. DockView supports window management functions such as minimizing, restoring, and closing windows, without modifying system files or the Dock itself. With DockView, users can manage multiple windows more efficiently and improve their productivity. DockView is a utility that adds previews to the windows of selected applications in the macOS Dock. When you hover your mouse over an app icon, thumbnails of all windows will appear. Simply click on the desired window to switch to it immediately. In addition, window thumbnails allow you to quickly close, minimize, and manage windows. Quick window switching: DockView allows users to quickly switch between windows of selected applications, improving work efficiency. Window management features: Users can easily minimize, restore, and close windows with DockView, making window management more convenient.

item.title: BuhoCleaner 1.17.1
item.description:
Mac System Cleanup, Uninstallation, and Optimization Tool

BuhoCleaner is the ultimate cleanup software designed for Mac users. It aims to free up storage space with its one-click quick cleanup feature, easily locating and deleting unnecessary files that take up a lot of storage space, thereby reclaiming gigabytes of space. It can easily find and clean up large and duplicate files, intuitively manage disk usage through the disk space analyzer, and quickly delete unnecessary files to free up space. BuhoCleaner offers a complete application uninstaller that can quickly and easily uninstall applications and all their residual data, including customized deep uninstall solutions for over 100 popular applications. It also optimizes Mac's startup time, significantly improving its responsiveness and startup speed by managing startup and login items and freeing up RAM.
